_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: He rose from supper, poured water, and washed their feet.
If I, your Lord, have washed your feet, so must you.
The cup of blessing is the cup of his blood.
We take the cup of salvation and call on his name.
A new commandment I give you.
Love one another as I have loved you.
Come, let us worship at the table he has set.
Love one another as I have loved you. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Feel the water, warm in the basin, and his hands at your feet, the towel at his waist, the Lord of all kneeling on the floor.
Love one another as I have loved you.
This is the night of the lamb, the blood on the doorpost, the bread eaten in haste with sandals on, ready to be set free.
Love one another as I have loved you.
He takes the bread and breaks it: this is my body, for you. He lifts the cup: this is my blood, do this and remember me.
Love one another as I have loved you.
What can we give back for all his goodness? We will lift the cup of salvation and call upon his name.
Love one another as I have loved you.
By this everyone will know you are mine: that you love one another. Come, let us worship and learn to kneel.
Love one another as I have loved you. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He kneels with a basin and towel and washes our feet.
Love one another as I have loved you.
He breaks the bread, he pours the cup: remember me.
Love one another as I have loved you.
We take the cup of salvation and call on his name.
Love one another as I have loved you.
Come, let us worship at the table he has set.
Love one another as I have loved you. Amen.
